warnings: Timber alternative of TRUSS T1 (see view1 for the steel one). Sizes are nominal inches; converted to integer mm (2"=51, 5"=127, 6"=152, 8"=203) with the print kept in width_mm_printed_as. Timber members have no steel_section and no rebar; material timber.

element_type for timber members reuses the closed vocabulary: rafter (จันทัน), tie_beam (ขื่อ), purlin (แป), accessory (พุก); ดั้ง/ค้ำยัน/สะพาน are truss members (element_type truss, part_of T1), as in view1.
Section mark B points to ขยายรูปตัด B on S-10.
